body.name: hoifHandle
body.construction: Construct a cross-fitted Hilbert-valued higher-order score from within-cell collision \(U\)-statistics on \(\mathcal B_h\), set \(M=K_h\), stabilize each occupied block by its empirical Gram matrix, and select \(h\) by the candidate bias--fluctuation balance \(h^t+n^{-1}K_h^{1/2}\Gamma_n(h;P_X)\). Couple the upper construction to the corrected paired \(P_\omega,Q_\omega\) family and use the cell-algebra and legality lemmas to keep the exact SCoDiTE null, covariance profile, and source constraint aligned with the lower experiment.
